subject: Coordinating on-site audit logistics and Art.28/30 evidence pull
messages:
From: Sarah Quinn <sarah.quinn@betahealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Audits Team <audits@betahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: On-site audit + Art.28/30 evidence pull

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last month. BetaHealth is scheduling an on-site audit (internal privacy office + external counsel) focused on data processing activities for our pilot integration. We need to validate a subset of Art.28/30 documentation, DPIA artifacts, and sampling of processing logs.

High level ask: can Redwood host an on-site evidence pull the week of Apr 19–23? Required artifacts:
- Article 30 ledger (export for the past 12 months)
- Subprocessor roster and execution dates
- DPIA summary and any recent change logs
- KMS audit summaries and sample access entries (redacted if necessary)
- Dataflow diagrams and retention settings for the relevant tenant

We attached a short audit scope. Also, counsel (Benjamin Anderson) will want to confirm the NDA and the boundaries for what can be viewed on-site vs. exported.

Can you confirm feasibility and what evidence we can provide ahead of time (drive link for CSVs / samples)?

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Quinn
Head of Privacy Operations, BetaHealth
Attachments: audit_scope_request.pdf (pdf)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Quinn <sarah.quinn@betahealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: On-site audit + Art.28/30 evidence pull

Hi Sarah — thanks for the scope and timeline. We can support an on-site review and a prior evidence pull. A few quick clarifying items before we lock dates:

1) Scope: does the team want the full 12-month Article 30 ledger or a scoped subset (production tenant + pilot project IDs)?
2) KMS logs: raw key material and complete audit trails are restricted. We can provide redacted KMS access summaries and a time-limited auditor workstation for deeper inspection under NDA. Is that acceptable?
3) Subprocessor roster: we maintain a running export; do you need signed contracts (execution dates) or inventory only?

Priyom and Marissa I’m looping in to confirm the export format and on-site logistics (room, network access, local point of contact). Lauren — can you prepare a preliminary evidence_inventory.xlsx with the proposed filenames and estimated delivery dates?

I’ll get back with confirmed dates and a secure Drive link for pre-reads by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Manager, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Request: On-site audit + Art.28/30 evidence pull

Folks — forwarding Sarah’s scope. Summary of asks we need to action:
- Art.30 ledger export (CSV) for tenant betahealth-prod (12 months)
- Subprocessor roster with signed/execution dates (contract metadata)
- DPIA summary + change log exports (DPIA tickets)
- KMS access summaries (redacted) + auditor workstation plan
- Dataflow diagrams and retention configs for the pilot integration

Constraints to note: full KMS raw logs cannot be exported to external buckets; we should plan for in-room inspection or in-Console auditor access with monitoring. Also need to confirm whether counsel will sign our standard audit NDA or want edits.

Can you respond with:
- realistic ETA for each artifact (CSV / spreadsheet)
- whether any items require legal review before sharing
- suggested list of filenames for the evidence_inventory.xlsx

Thanks — Sarah asked for an on-site week of Apr 19–23. That gives ~2 weeks to prepare pre-reads.

— Neha
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Request: On-site audit + Art.28/30 evidence pull

Quick plan and ETA:

Artifacts we can produce and ETA (business days):
- art30-ledger-export-20270405.csv — 2 days (generated, sanitized headers)
- subprocessor-roster-20270405.csv (includes execution dates) — 2 days
- dpia-summary-202702.pdf and dpia-change-log.csv — 3 days
- dataflow-diagram-betahealth.pdf — 4 days (we’ll pull from infra diagrams and label flows)
- evidence_inventory.xlsx (index of files + checksums + delivery) — 2 days

KMS and sensitive items:
- We cannot push raw KMS audit trails to external buckets. Proposed options:
  a) Provide redacted KMS access summary + ACL snapshots (exportable)
  b) Provide a locked auditor VM at our site with ephemeral access and live screen-sharing (recommended)
  c) Allow counsel to review logs in our secure room; no raw copy leaves Redwood without special approvals

Legal review: our standard audit NDA covers an on-site review and access pattern (VM/room). If Benjamin requests edits, please route to Legal; that may add 3–4 business days.

Attachments to prepare this week: evidence_inventory.xlsx, art30-ledger-export-20270405.csv (sample), redaction-plan.pdf

I’ll start the Art.30 export job now and put files into a restricted Drive folder: https://drive.restricted/redwood/betahealth/audit-2027.

— Priyom
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Quinn <sarah.quinn@betahealth.com>, Benjamin Anderson <benjamin@anderson-legal.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 10:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: On-site audit + Art.28/30 evidence pull

Hi Sarah / Benjamin —

We can proceed with the onsite week of Apr 19–23. Pre-reads we will place in a secure Drive folder by Apr 9 EOD. Preliminary deliverables we will upload:
- art30-ledger-export-20270405.csv (Article 30 ledger, sanitized)
- subprocessor-roster-20270405.csv (contract execution dates included)
- evidence_inventory.xlsx (index + delivery ETA)
- dpia-summary-202702.pdf and dpia-change-log.csv
- dataflow-diagram-betahealth.pdf
- redaction-plan.pdf (KMS/restricted items)

For KMS/auditor access: please review the redaction-plan. Our recommended approach is a locked auditor VM accessible only on-site and monitored by Redwood staff. If your counsel requires raw log exports, we will need a signed addendum to the standard audit NDA and an internal approval (timeline +3–5 business days). I’ve attached the DocuSign-ready NDA (NDA-BetaHealth-Redwood) — please sign that and return.

Link to folder (restricted): https://drive.restricted/redwood/betahealth/audit-2027
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/na/nda-betahealth

Let me know if you need anything else before the 9th.

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Manager, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: nda-betahealth-docusign.pdf (pdf)
From: Sarah Quinn <sarah.quinn@betahealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Audits Team <audits@betahealth.com>, Benjamin Anderson <benjamin@anderson-legal.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: On-site audit + Art.28/30 evidence pull

Thanks Neha — that timeline works for us. A couple of quick follow-ups from counsel:

1) Can you confirm whether the subprocessor roster includes CloudEdge Storage (we flagged that vendor earlier)?
2) For the Article 30 CSV, can you include a sample of processing purposes and categories for the pilot tenant? Not the full record set — just a 5% sample for pre-review.

We will have Benjamin sign the NDA today and the Audits team will review the pre-reads after Apr 9.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Sarah
